scripts.check:no-deno: if grep -rqE 'deno\.land|Deno\.' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=specs .; then echo 'Deno references remain'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:relay-pure: if [ ! -d server ] || [ ! -f shared/protocol/frame.ts ]; then echo 'the paths this check reads are missing; it would pass vacuously'; exit 1; fi; if grep -rqE "from ['\"].*crypto/" server/ shared/protocol/frame.ts; then echo 'relay imports crypto'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:no-secret-props: test -f src/tui/App.tsx || { echo 'check:no-secret-props: App.tsx missing'; exit 1; }; ! grep -rnE '\b(secretKey|psk|root|chainLoHi|chainHiLo|sendChain|recvChain)\b' src/tui/
scripts.check:no-v1:
for f in shared/crypto/derive.ts shared/crypto/identity.ts shared/termino-dir.ts src/trust.ts src/replay.ts test/shared/crypto/derive.test.ts test/shared/crypto/identity.test.ts test/trust.test.ts test/replay.test.ts test/tui/verify.test.tsx; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "check:no-v1: $f still exists"; exit 1; fi
done
test -f shared/crypto/handshake.ts || { echo 'check:no-v1: handshake.ts missing'; exit 1; }
if grep -rniE 'argon2' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' src shared server test; then
  echo 'check:no-v1: argon2 references remain'; exit 1
fi
if grep -rn 'ed25519' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' src shared server test | grep -v '^shared/crypto/handshake.ts:.*@noble/curves/ed25519.js'; then
  echo 'check:no-v1: ed25519 references remain'; exit 1
fi
scripts.check:no-persistence:
test -f src/session.ts || { echo 'check:no-persistence: session.ts missing'; exit 1; }
if grep -rnE '\.termino|identity\.key|known_keys\.json' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' src shared server test; then
  echo 'check:no-persistence: persistence references remain'; exit 1
fi
